verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is a retail/commerce SaaS platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The adjacent items do not count: Sidekick is a built-in assistant, the GraphQL Admin API and POS UI extensions are conventional developer surfaces, and llms.txt is crawler/agent documentation rather than an MCP server.
